structural_verification.task_digest_explanation: The existing registry uses file-byte SHA256 for eight frozen tasks and SHA256(json.dumps(task, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)) without a newline for twenty eval33-release tasks. All twenty-eight objects equal the actual task.json; these two pre-existing digest conventions are preserved and are not described as twenty-eight equal file-byte hashes.
checks: All modified records bind the current task, prompt, inputs and required deliverables.
All five dimensions are present with weights 0.30/0.20/0.20/0.20/0.10; item IDs are unique and weights remain one.
All items have distinct 0/0.5/1 anchors, no scores, actual deliverable bindings and current input or prompt source SHA256.
D5 requires visual evidence; unsupported fabricated quote/span metadata is absent from the new locator-design schema.
Each explicit comparison has an authored comparison scope and named required sides; other items preserve independent present content.

shared_resolutions.resolution: Final records preserve authored content scope and canonical dependency metadata; all twenty-four explicit comparison items name their required sides. Missing comparison evidence zeros that comparison only, without zeroing independent present content.
New records remove old author/reviewer notes, review shard claims and review record pointers. Current authorship and retrospective status are separate from prior rubric provenance.

The new v2-locator-design schema explicitly stores source locators with current prompt/input SHA256. It does not fabricate literal quotes or resolved spans; the other 222 v1 records retain their original bytes.

New D2 anchors and deduction scopes evaluate coverage and omission. Existing fact, scope, independent reasoning and visual defects have separate primary owners; recovered tool/process costs are not Q penalties.
TSR design now explicitly retains a null complete TSR when any task is UNSCORED and permits fixed-denominator lower and upper bounds. Unknown is neither silently zeroed nor removed.
